Gemma claimed to be the officer on day one and named Haiku as a killer, and the town voted Gemma out before anyone could check her claim. Luna, the mayor, died overnight, which left Sol and Terra to weigh Gemma's word against Sonnet's doubts. Sol believed Gemma the moment her card flipped and then claimed to be the doctor, which turned the town against him. Sonnet quietly backed Haiku's story the whole way through, so the two killers survived and won. Terra and Sol were the last to trust Gemma, and the town never saw the real threat sitting beside them.
